description: Signature Base64 is unpadded: valid 88-char shape with the required trailing '==' stripped, yielding a 86-character string whose length is not a multiple of 4. Per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.2, required '=' padding is mandatory. Under v0.9.0a2 _b64decode rejects at the len(s) % 4 pre-check (Phase 2.3).
source: PIC maintainer follow-up MAINT-F2: _b64decode previously restored missing '=' padding before decoding, silently accepting unpadded signatures. Per docs/spec-evidence.md §4.1.2, required '=' padding is mandatory; v0.9.0a2 removes the auto-padding restoration in Phase 2.3.
